title: Corporate Law
tagline: Structuring, governance and compliance for businesses at every stage.
overview: Our corporate practice advises founders, promoters, family businesses and established companies on the full commercial lifecycle — from choosing the right entity and drafting a founders' agreement, to negotiating investment rounds, restructuring shareholdings and planning an exit.

We combine transactional drafting with a working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, FEMA and SEBI regulations, so the paperwork we produce holds up under scrutiny from regulators, investors and, if it comes to it, a court. Where a matter touches tax, banking or a dispute already before a court, we bring in the relevant partner rather than working around the gap.
servicesOffered: Company, LLP and partnership incorporation and structuring
Shareholders' agreements, joint ventures and founders' agreements
Commercial contract drafting, review and negotiation
Mergers, acquisitions and business transfer agreements
Corporate governance, board advisory and secretarial compliance
Due diligence for investment and acquisition transactions

process.title: Commercial briefing
process.description: We start with what the business is trying to achieve, not the document you think you need. Often the right instrument is different from the one requested.

process.title: Structure and risk mapping
process.description: We set out the available structures with their tax, liability and compliance consequences, and flag the two or three risks that genuinely matter.

process.title: Drafting and negotiation
process.description: We draft the documentation, mark up counterparty drafts and represent you in negotiations, keeping a clear record of every concession and its rationale.

process.title: Execution and ongoing compliance
process.description: We manage signing, statutory filings and post-closing conditions, then hand over a compliance calendar so nothing lapses quietly.

benefits: Documentation drafted to survive litigation, not just to close a deal
Single point of contact across corporate, tax and regulatory questions
Fixed-fee quotes for defined transactional scopes
Compliance calendars that prevent avoidable penalties
metaDescription: Corporate law advisory for incorporation, shareholders' agreements, M&A, due diligence and governance compliance. Speak to Singla & Singla Law Firm.

title: Civil Litigation
tagline: Assertive representation in contract, recovery and declaratory disputes.
overview: We appear in civil suits before trial courts, District Courts, the High Court and appellate forums in matters ranging from breach of contract and money recovery to specific performance, injunctions, partition and declaratory relief.

Civil litigation in India rewards preparation and punishes drift. We invest heavily in pleadings and documentary groundwork at the outset, because a well-framed plaint or written statement shapes every hearing that follows — and frequently produces a settlement on better terms than a judgment would.
servicesOffered: Suits for recovery of money and damages
Breach of contract and specific performance claims
Injunctions, stay applications and interim relief
Partition, declaration and possession suits
Execution of decrees and enforcement proceedings
Civil appeals, revisions and writ petitions

process.title: Case assessment
process.description: We review your documents against limitation, jurisdiction and cause of action, and tell you candidly how strong the claim is before you commit to it.

process.title: Notice and settlement attempt
process.description: A properly drafted legal notice resolves a meaningful share of disputes. Where it does not, it strengthens the record for the suit that follows.

process.title: Pleadings and interim relief
process.description: We file the plaint or written statement with a complete documentary compilation, and move immediately for interim protection where assets or possession are at risk.

process.title: Trial, judgment and execution
process.description: We conduct evidence and arguments, and follow through on execution — a decree that is never enforced is not a result.

benefits: Honest merits assessment before you incur litigation costs
Interim relief pursued early to protect assets and possession
Written hearing updates after every listed date
Execution handled as part of the mandate, not as an afterthought
metaDescription: Civil litigation lawyers for recovery suits, breach of contract, injunctions, partition and civil appeals. Get a candid case assessment.

title: Criminal Defense
tagline: Urgent, discreet defence at every stage — from FIR to appeal.
overview: We defend individuals and companies across the criminal process: anticipatory and regular bail, quashing of FIRs, trial defence, and appeals. We also act for complainants where a genuine offence has been met with police inaction.

Criminal matters are decided in the first seventy-two hours as often as at trial. Our priority in a new brief is immediate — secure liberty, preserve the client's ability to answer the allegation, and prevent avoidable damage to reputation. All criminal instructions are handled with strict confidentiality and, where required, under legal professional privilege.
servicesOffered: Anticipatory bail, regular bail and interim protection
Quashing petitions and challenges to FIRs and charge sheets
Trial defence before Magistrate and Sessions Courts
Economic offence, white-collar and fraud defence
Criminal appeals, revisions and suspension of sentence
Representation in police investigation and summons

process.title: Immediate response
process.description: We take urgent criminal calls outside office hours. The first conversation covers custody risk, what to say to the police, and what not to sign.

process.title: Protecting liberty
process.description: We move for anticipatory or regular bail at the appropriate forum without delay, and seek interim protection where arrest is imminent.

process.title: Building the defence
process.description: We obtain the case diary and prosecution material, identify contradictions, and prepare a defence theory supported by documents and witnesses.

process.title: Trial and appellate stages
process.description: We conduct cross-examination and final arguments, and pursue appeal or revision where the outcome warrants it.

benefits: Availability for genuinely urgent arrest and custody situations
Strict confidentiality on every criminal instruction
Clear guidance on conduct during investigation
Defence strategy explained in plain language, in writing
metaDescription: Criminal defence advocates for bail, FIR quashing, trial defence and criminal appeals. Confidential consultation available.

title: Family Law
tagline: Steady counsel on custody, maintenance, guardianship and succession.
overview: We advise on child custody and guardianship, maintenance and interim maintenance, domestic violence proceedings, adoption, and succession and inheritance disputes across the personal laws applicable in India.

Family matters carry consequences that outlast the litigation, particularly where children are involved. We push for negotiated and mediated outcomes wherever they are achievable and safe, and litigate firmly where they are not. Where there are allegations of violence or coercion, protection comes before procedure.
servicesOffered: Child custody, visitation and guardianship petitions
Maintenance and interim maintenance claims and defences
Domestic violence complaints and protection orders
Adoption and legal guardianship documentation
Succession certificates, probate and inheritance disputes
Family settlement and partition agreements

process.title: Private consultation
process.description: A confidential session to understand the family situation, the immediate risks, and what outcome would actually work for you.

process.title: Protection and interim orders
process.description: Where there is risk to a spouse or child, or a maintenance shortfall, we seek interim relief before the main proceeding advances.

process.title: Negotiation or mediation
process.description: We attempt a settlement or mediated parenting arrangement where it is safe and realistic, documented so it is enforceable.

process.title: Court proceedings
process.description: Where settlement fails, we conduct the petition through evidence and arguments, keeping the child's interest at the centre of the case.

benefits: Consultations handled with discretion and without judgement
Settlement pursued first, litigation conducted firmly when needed
Realistic guidance on custody and maintenance outcomes
Enforceable documentation for negotiated arrangements
metaDescription: Family law advocates for child custody, maintenance, guardianship, domestic violence and succession matters. Confidential consultation.

title: Divorce Law
tagline: Mutual-consent and contested divorce, handled with discretion.
overview: We act in mutual-consent and contested divorce petitions, judicial separation, nullity, and the financial and custodial questions that accompany them — alimony, permanent maintenance, division of assets and parenting arrangements.

A mutual-consent divorce that is properly documented is faster, cheaper and far less damaging than a contested one. We test whether that route is available in every matter before advising otherwise, and where a contest is unavoidable, we prepare for it thoroughly from the first hearing.
servicesOffered: Mutual-consent divorce petitions and settlement deeds
Contested divorce on statutory grounds
Alimony, permanent maintenance and asset division
Judicial separation and nullity petitions
Custody and parenting arrangements within divorce proceedings
Transfer petitions and NRI divorce matters

process.title: Confidential assessment
process.description: We identify the applicable personal law, the available grounds, and whether a mutual-consent route is realistically achievable.

process.title: Terms of settlement
process.description: Where consent is possible, we negotiate and draft settlement terms covering maintenance, assets and custody so nothing resurfaces later.

process.title: Petition and appearances
process.description: We file the petition, prepare you for statements before the court, and manage the statutory waiting period and its waiver where available.

process.title: Decree and enforcement
process.description: We obtain the decree and, where required, enforce maintenance or property terms that are not voluntarily honoured.

benefits: Mutual-consent route tested first to reduce cost and conflict
Settlement deeds drafted to be final and enforceable
Sensitive handling of matters involving children
Experience with NRI and transfer petition complications
metaDescription: Divorce lawyers for mutual consent and contested divorce, alimony, maintenance and custody. Discreet, practical advice.

title: Property Law
tagline: Title diligence, transfers and possession disputes resolved cleanly.
overview: We handle title verification, sale and transfer documentation, mutation and registration, partition of joint family property, and disputes over possession, easements and encroachment.

Most property litigation traces back to a document that was signed without diligence. We would rather spend a week verifying a title chain than three years litigating it, and we say so plainly when a proposed transaction should not proceed on the papers available.
servicesOffered: Title search, verification and legal opinion
Sale deeds, gift deeds, lease deeds and agreements to sell
Registration, stamp duty advisory and mutation
Partition suits and family property division
Possession, encroachment and easement disputes
Landlord and tenant disputes and eviction proceedings

process.title: Document review
process.description: We examine the title chain, revenue records and encumbrances, and issue a written opinion identifying every defect we find.

process.title: Risk decision
process.description: We distinguish defects that can be cured from those that cannot, so you can decide whether to proceed, renegotiate or walk away.

process.title: Documentation and registration
process.description: We draft and register the operative documents, advise on stamp duty, and complete mutation in the revenue records.

process.title: Dispute resolution
process.description: Where a dispute already exists, we pursue injunction, declaration or possession relief, or negotiate a documented settlement.

benefits: Written title opinions that state risk plainly
Stamp duty and registration handled end to end
Clear advice on when not to buy
Revenue record follow-through after registration
metaDescription: Property lawyers for title verification, sale deeds, registration, partition suits and possession disputes. Get a written title opinion.

title: Consumer Protection
tagline: Holding builders, insurers and service providers to their promises.
overview: We represent consumers before the District, State and National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions in complaints against builders, insurers, banks, hospitals, e-commerce platforms and service providers.

Consumer forums are designed to be accessible, and the remedies — refund, compensation, interest and litigation costs — are real. We also defend businesses facing consumer complaints, which gives us a working sense of how these cases are actually argued and settled.
servicesOffered: Complaints against builders for delayed or defective possession
Insurance claim repudiation and deficiency of service
Banking, NBFC and financial service complaints
Medical negligence and professional deficiency claims
E-commerce, unfair trade practice and misleading advertisement matters
Defence of businesses in consumer commission proceedings

process.title: Deficiency assessment
process.description: We check whether the facts amount to a deficiency in service or unfair trade practice, and confirm the correct forum and pecuniary limit.

process.title: Notice and documentation
process.description: We issue a notice and assemble the paper trail — contracts, receipts, correspondence — that consumer commissions decide cases on.

process.title: Filing the complaint
process.description: We draft and file the complaint with a clear, quantified prayer for refund, compensation and interest.

process.title: Hearing and execution
process.description: We argue the matter and pursue execution of the order, including recovery proceedings where the opposite party delays.

Correct forum and valuation chosen at the outset
Quantified compensation claims, not vague prayers
Execution pursued until the award is actually paid
metaDescription: Consumer protection lawyers for builder delays, insurance claim rejection, medical negligence and unfair trade practices.

title: Cheque Bounce
tagline: Section 138 complaints and defence, driven to recovery rather than a decree.
overview: We act for payees prosecuting dishonoured cheques under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, and for drawers defending those complaints — alongside the parallel summary suit under Order XXXVII that is often the faster route to the money itself.

Cheque bounce matters are won or lost on dates. The demand notice must issue within thirty days of the bank memo, the drawer gets fifteen days to pay, and the complaint must be filed within the month that follows. We calendar those windows the day you instruct us, because a notice sent a day late converts a strong case into no case at all.
servicesOffered: Statutory demand notices under Section 138 within the limitation window
Filing and conduct of Section 138 complaints before the Magistrate
Defence of drawers, including challenges to notice, service and legally enforceable debt
Summary suits under Order XXXVII for recovery of the cheque amount with interest
Interim compensation and appeal applications under Section 143A and 148
Compounding, settlement and execution of the compensation order

process.title: Memo and limitation check
process.description: We read the return memo, the underlying transaction and the dates. Before anything else, you are told exactly how many days remain on each statutory window.

process.title: Demand notice
process.description: We draft and dispatch the notice by registered post and email with proof of service, framed so the debt and the demand are unambiguous on the face of it.

process.title: Complaint or defence
process.description: If payment does not follow, we file the complaint with the bank records and notice trail annexed — or, for a drawer, we test whether the debt was legally enforceable and whether the notice was validly served.

process.title: Settlement, trial and recovery
process.description: Most of these matters settle once summons issue, and we negotiate on that footing. Where they do not, we conduct the trial and then execute the compensation order until it is actually paid.

benefits: Statutory deadlines diarised at intake so the remedy is never lost
Parallel summary suit advised where recovery, not conviction, is the object
Interim compensation pursued under Section 143A while the trial runs
Execution followed through — an order on paper is not payment
metaDescription: Cheque bounce lawyers for Section 138 complaints, demand notices, drawer defence, Order XXXVII summary suits and recovery of the cheque amount.

title: Arbitration & Mediation
tagline: Private, faster resolution of commercial disputes.
overview: We act as counsel in domestic and international commercial arbitrations, draft and stress-test arbitration clauses, and represent clients in Section 9 and Section 34 proceedings before the courts under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

Arbitration delivers speed and privacy when the clause is well drafted and the process is run tightly. It delivers neither when the clause is copied from an unrelated contract. We spend real time on the dispute resolution clause at the drafting stage, because that is where arbitration succeeds or fails.
servicesOffered: Drafting and review of arbitration and dispute resolution clauses
Counsel in domestic and international commercial arbitration
Interim measures under Section 9 and Section 17
Challenge and enforcement of arbitral awards
Institutional and ad-hoc arbitrator appointment
Commercial mediation and conciliation

process.title: Invocation and constitution
process.description: We issue the notice of arbitration and manage constitution of the tribunal, including court applications where appointment stalls.

process.title: Pleadings and hearings
process.description: We prepare statements of claim or defence, documentary compilations and witness evidence, and argue the hearings.

process.title: Award, challenge or enforcement

benefits: Arbitration clauses drafted to work under pressure
Confidential process that keeps commercial disputes out of public record
Interim protection secured while the reference proceeds
Enforcement strategy planned before the award is delivered

Cyber matters are time-sensitive in a way most litigation is not: evidence disappears, funds move, and content spreads. Our first step is always preservation — freezing the trail through the correct complaint channels while the remedy is worked out.

Online financial fraud, phishing and UPI fraud recovery
Content takedown, online defamation and impersonation
Data protection and privacy compliance advisory
Data breach response and regulatory notification
IT Act, intermediary liability and cyber defence matters

process.title: Takedown or recovery action

process.title: Compliance hardening

benefits: Same-day guidance on preserving digital evidence
Practical fraud recovery route through banks and platforms
Discreet handling of reputation and defamation matters
Compliance advice that reduces the chance of a repeat
metaDescription: Cyber law advocates for online fraud recovery, cybercrime complaints, content takedown, defamation and data protection compliance.

Tax disputes are won on documentation created long before the notice arrives. We advise on positions prospectively where we can, and where a notice has already issued, we respond on the record with the material that supports the position actually taken in the return.

GST registration, compliance, audits and show-cause notices
Appeals before CIT(A), ITAT and appellate authorities
Tax planning for transactions and business restructuring
Search, survey and summons representation
Penalty, prosecution and rectification proceedings

process.title: Appellate proceedings
process.description: We prepare grounds, paper books and case law compilations, and argue the appeal before the Tribunal or High Court.

Stay of demand pursued alongside the appeal
Coordination with your accountant rather than duplication
Prospective advice that reduces future exposure

overview: We act for borrowers, guarantors, lenders and financial creditors in recovery proceedings, SARFAESI enforcement, Debt Recovery Tribunal matters and insolvency proceedings under the IBC.

Borrowers frequently engage counsel only after possession notice, by which point the available remedies have narrowed. Early advice on restructuring, one-time settlement or a securitisation application usually produces a materially better outcome than a late challenge.

Debt Recovery Tribunal and DRAT proceedings
One-time settlement and loan restructuring negotiation
Loan recall notices, NPA classification and account challenges
Insolvency and bankruptcy proceedings before the NCLT
Guarantor liability and mortgage enforcement disputes
